items.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever , Blizzard's next evolution of WoW Classic that will see significant changes and co

content.v: World of Warcraft: Forever , Blizzard's next evolution of WoW Classic that will see significant changes and content additions, is fully playable on controller.

I got to experience WoW: Forever's new Skyborne elf starting zone with the control scheme during a hands-on demo at BlizzCon 2026 . A prompt outlining the controls noted controller support was in an "alpha" state, but despite supposedly still being in early development, it worked surprisingly well.

That's a first for Blizzard's MMORPG. Though Blizzard has added barebones support for controllers in recent years, an entirely mouse-and-keyboard-free setup relies on unofficial, player-made add-ons like ConsolePort to deliver a true console-like experience.

From what I played at BlizzCon, Blizzard adding a fully featured controller option could be a game-changer. Despite having played WoW on a mouse and keyboard for 22 years, I was shocked at how natural it felt. Cycling through friendly or enemy NPCs is done with the shoulder buttons. Interacting and jumping are done with the face buttons. Abilities and spells are bound to both the d-pad and the face buttons, with additional keybinds accessible by pressing one or both triggers. Each trigger provides access to eight keybinds, with another eight from holding down both triggers at the same time. Combined with the d-pad, you have 28 buttons at your fingertips.

That sounds like a lot of buttons, but in some scenarios, particularly in WoW Classic or WoW: Forever, it might not be enough. Certain classes, particularly spellcasters, are notorious for having access to an almost comical number of skills and abilities in WoW Classic. This is largely due to many spells having multiple ranks, with lower ranked versions doing less damage or healing but also costing less mana. That makes them still useful in certain situations, but definitely clutters up one's action bars.

Outside of the actual basics of using combat abilities and talking to NPCs, WoW: Forever's controller support felt a little more cumbersome. On keyboard and mouse, opening your inventory is as easy as hitting the "b" key and then clicking what you want. On a controller, it requires bringing up a radial menu, sliding over to the inventory section, and then cycling through all the items in your bag until you reach the one you're looking for. Considering players can have dozens of items in their bags at once, trying to select what you want definitely feels slower and less straightforward than is ideal.

Ultimately, full controller support for WoW: Forever might be more suited for some classes or particular playstyles over others. The modern "retail" version of WoW, currently in the middle of its most recent Midnight expansion, would arguably benefit from controller support even more than WoW Classic or Forever. Modern WoW generally has fewer buttons to press and less inventory management to do, and I could see this controller setup working wonders for those who want to run some delves on their couch or casually complete world quests.

Blizzard's full plans for WoW controller support aren't currently clear. The demo labeled controller support as an alpha, and Blizzard announced during the show Forever will be fully playable with a controller come launch on November 4. It made no announcements regarding if the feature will eventually come to retail, though considering how much DNA is now being shared between the multiple versions of WoW, it seems safe to assume it will. GameSpot has reached out to Blizzard for comment and clarification about its plans for controller support, and will update this post if we hear back.

The elephant in the room is whether Blizzard's controller initiative will pave the way for an eventual console version. Blizzard is, of course, currently owned by Microsoft, the owner of Xbox. Fans have speculated given WoW: Midnight's user-made add-on restrictions (something that will carry over into Forever) and its pruning of many class abilities last year that Blizzard was setting the table for a console version.

It wouldn't be too shocking to see WoW at long last make its debut on Xbox, though Blizzard made clear last year that if it were making a console version, it would tell fans about it . Handheld PCs, including Xbox-branded ones, are also more popular than ever before, and WoW receiving full controller support would open the way for the MMO to be officially playable on those devices as well.

Regardless of whether a console version eventually happens, having a fully functioning controller option still feels long overdue from a simple accessibility standpoint on PC. Seeing that Blizzard is finally hard at work delivering one is nothing but good news. From what I played, it's simple, intuitive, and perhaps even easier in some ways than playing on mouse and keyboard, though I'm sure there are scenarios, like inventory management, where it might leave something to be desired. Whatever Blizzard's full plans for controller support are, it can't come soon enough.

items.summary: A British Pokémon card store has denied giving celebrities special treatment during a 30th Anniversary Pokémon

others.title: HP Omen 35L (2026) review

content.v: A British Pokémon card store has denied giving celebrities special treatment during a 30th Anniversary Pokémon card launch that left customers who had queued for hours empty handed.

Geek Retreat Chelmsford, a gaming and collectible retailer in southern England, was one of the thousands of stores to hold a special opening yesterday, in order to sell the latest set of highly sought after Pokémon cards.

Alongside hundreds of average shoppers, however, were a pair of notable UK figures: Stacey Solomon and Joe Swash, a reality TV star couple seen on shows such as The X Factor, Dancing on Ice, and I'm a Celebrity... Get Me Out of Here!

In a widely-shared video posted online, the situation outside Geek Retreat Chelmsford can be seen descending into chaos, as shoppers discover the store's stock has rapidly sold out. Numerous posts from customers via X/Twitter and Facebook claim that they had been told told by staff not to queue or park directly outside before opening in order to deter scalpers — but that this did not apply when Solomon and Swash turned up, and reported parked directly in front of the store.

"They parked right outside, skipped the queue and bought most of the stock, leaving about 10 items for the 200+ people still waiting," wrote WeLovePokémon, a fan account with more than 82,000 followers.

Worst 30th Celebration story I’ve seen. Geek Retreat Chelmsford told customers they weren’t allowed to queue until 30 mins before opening, they weren’t allowed to park outside the shop, and there would be a 1pp limit. All of that went out the window when two celebrities (Joe… pic.twitter.com/j72bNCaFS2

However, Geek Retreat Chelmsford has now issued a statement to contest this account, call for calm as its Facebook page is flooded with negative reviews, and ask that its customers' anger not be directed at employees.

"We would like to address some of the negativity and aggression we have received today," the store wrote. "Today we ran the release of the Pokémon 30th Anniversary set in a way that we genuinely believed would best support our customers, maintain fairness and help reduce scalping. Unfortunately, we were never going to have enough stock to meet the demand, and we understand that this was disappointing for people who were unable to get everything they wanted.

"What we cannot accept, however, is that this disappointment has been directed towards our staff. Our staff work incredibly hard to make the shop a welcoming place for everyone. We are always happy to listen to genuine feedback, but abuse, aggression or threats towards our team are not acceptable under any circumstances. Anyone who has threatened or abused a member of our staff will not be welcome in our store.

"We would also like to address the suggestion that certain people, including well-known individuals, were given special treatment today. This is simply not true. We did not know that any famous people were attending until we saw them outside. They were not allowed in early, they were not given extra stock, and they were subject to exactly the same one of each product per-person limits as everyone else. They happened to be second in the queue when we opened, and no member of our team allowed them to skip the queue."

Despite the statement, the negative reviews remain. "30th celebrations release was a joke, store ordered 25 ETBs, chased customers down the road to prevent queuing which we all respected and understood as a method to combat scalping etc, yet quickly changed their minds when Joe Swash turned up, parked outside the store (another thing they said publically we were not to do) and then allowed him with his wife and multiple children to jump the queue and buy the majority of the stock. Outrageous display of poor management and poor choices, staff should be ashamed," reads one comment.
"Breaks protocol to sell to 'celebrities' who only purchased product to flip on their whatnot site, then makes a sob story post as if they're the victims when customers notice," wrote another.

"Horrendous behavior," wrote a third. "Everyone was told to not queue before 11.30am and do not loiter around the front of the shop, even in your motors. Joe Swash and Stacey Solomon, along with three other people, got out of their van, parked directly outside the shop, walked straight in past everyone and came out with half of the stock. Around 10 customers then came out with stock, until we had to be told by a customer who received nothing, that they were now out of stock. Hundreds of customers have been let down by you and your staff today."

Geek Retreat Chelmsford said it did allow some regular customers to pre-order stock, but acknowledged that there was simply no way to avoid some disappointment "when demand massively exceeds supply." No comment was made on where Swash and Solomon parked, or how many cards they and their children bought overall.

Yesterday, we reported on the long queues and the phenomenon of "ghost chairs" outside stores in the U.K., France, and the U.S. , as some fans waited in line for days ahead of the 30th Anniversary card set going on sale.

Pokémon cards have become a prime target for scalpers and thieves over the past few years due to their soaring popularity and the perceived value of rare cards. New card releases frequently sell out completely, and The Pokémon Company has appeared unable to keep up with demand — despite a staggering 10 billion cards printed last year alone .

Earlier this week, one millionaire Pokémon collector suggested that the cards will likely be used as currency following a global apocalypse . Looking to start your collection? We've also got a list of the 10 most expensive Pokémon cards of 2026 so far , and a first look at Mega Evolution's Delta Reign expansion , set to release in November this year.

Valor Mortis 团队 One More Level 认为，他们创造的第一人称《魂》具有全价 PS5 版本的“质量、保真度和游戏时间”，因此决定将即将推出的游戏定价为 39.99 美元。

content.v: "Get away from this year, you --".
Developer Cold Iron Studios has announced that Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 for the Switch 2 has been delayed into early 2027 .

As covered by IGN , the team believes that the extra time in the oven will allow it to deliver "the best possible version for the hardware". No specific date has been provided, but 'early 2027' suggests we'll probably see it at some point between January and March. The original release date was set for 29th September 2026.

items.title: Twitch 首席执行官表示 GTA 6 多人游戏将于 2027 年推出
items.summary: Rockstar has described GTA 6 as a "single-player experience," but everyone expects the game to eventually incl

content.v: Rockstar has described GTA 6 as a "single-player experience," but everyone expects the game to eventually include a multiplayer element given the enormous success of the existing GTA Online. But when could GTA 6's online multiplayer release? According to Twitch CEO Dan Clancy, fans can expect it sometime in 2027.

He said this in an interview with Bloomberg ( via IGN ), saying Twitch spent "a lot of time talking with Rockstar about their plans." He said Twitch stands to benefit from GTA 6's release, too, because content creators will flock to it and stream footage on Twitch. But Clancy theorized an "even bigger" bump to Twitch numbers could come in 2027 "when they launch multiplayer."
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Ambrosia_06_b1ae4c.jpg?w=636

To be sure, Rockstar has not announced anything at all related to multiplayer support for GTA 6. Given that Clancy said his teams had been engaged with Rockstar, his comments come across as more than just random guesswork.

GTA 5 also did not launch with multiplayer support. The game released on September 17, 2013, with GTA Online debuting a few weeks later . What Clancy is suggesting is a longer period between the single-player and multiplayer releases.

GTA Online has been enormously successful, bringing in lots of money from microtransactions over the years. The game has a dedicated fanbase of passionate players, which might make it challenging for Rockstar to convince people to move on to a new version .
GTA 6 releases on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. A PC edition is expected to follow.

items.title: Industry vet who worked on Ultima Online says the next big thing needs to have 'sh*tty graphics' to escape the doom of rising development costs
items.summary: "What used to be a single 128x128 texture is now multiple 4K textures."

content.v: The industry obsession with high-resolution graphics has haunted it for years, but given the dire state of things in regards to both layoffs and hardware prices ? It's now starting to be downright incompatible.

Raph Koster, a veteran developer who worked on Ultima Online and was the creative director for Star Wars Galaxies—and is now making another MMO, Stars Reach —has been banging that particular drum for years.

"I think the first time I spoke about, ‘Hey, cost is going to kill us’ was 2005," he tells our friends at Edge Magazine in a massive interview inside Issue 428 . "Myhrvold’s Law says that software is a gas—it expands to fill whatever computer you have … The place that shows up the most in games, for better or worse, is in content costs."

Reiterating similar thoughts spoken to me when I chatted to him back in June , Koster says that "what used to be a single 128x128 texture is now multiple 4K textures with shaders and all this stuff. And, yes, tools have improved along the way. You don’t handpaint that texture pixel by pixel any more—you can use procedural tools like Substance, or just purchase it from a texture library or whatever.

"But there’s still [a] downstream cost, even if it’s just testing how those umpteen textures and shaders interact. It all adds up." Combine that with the fact that game prices haven't gone up in parallel to these ballooning development costs, thanks to constant deals—"who buys something at $60, even, today?"—and you've got a recipe for disaster.

A cyclical one, mind. "Unless we hit the singularity," Koster says, "a platform will come along that changes things." Koster lays out a few key qualities this hypothetical platform would require in order to save the industry (or at least, the developers working within it) from this steadily-approaching iceberg:

"It needs to provide a new affordance, meaning there has to be gameplay you cannot get except on that platform … [it needs to be] worse for making traditional games—because that means the big incumbents cannot just transfer their expertise, come in and dominate.

And to top it all off? "The number-one biggest thing this new platform needs is to have shitty graphics." Referring to a few historical examples, like Flash games, social games on Facebook, the Wii, and mobile. That's not to say these platforms'll be immune to those problems, though.
"They eventually catch up, and then the costs rise in exactly the same way. But we haven’t had a new platform come along to reset that cost curve in a long time. Like, a long time."

items.title: The lead developer of the PS5 Linux project has abandoned ship: 'It is just a bunch of noobs using LLMs and writing hacks they don't even understand':
items.summary: The project, apparently, is "all down the sink."

content.v: If you remember a very cool project we reported on a few months ago that got Ubuntu Linux up and running on PlayStation 5 consoles, I have some bad news: the lead developer of the open-source project, Andy Nguyen, has stepped away:

"I am stepping away from the PS5 scene and stopping all my work on PS5 Linux," Nguyen posted on X . "After pouring my heart and months of my life into it, including plans to finish PS5 Pro support and release in 2027, it's all down the sink."

"The scene used to be a group of highly talented researchers, but now it is just a bunch of noobs using LLMs and writing hacks they don't even understand. Slop kiddies found the only hypervisor bug left, which I had also found a while ago, and decided to report to Sony."

The project , which was run by Nguyen, used hypervisor bugs to get Ubuntu Linux working on the PS5. Once past Sony's barriers, open-source Mesa drivers were tweaked to get everything working as it should, but you had to stay on older firmware to prevent Sony's patches "fixing" the hypervisor bugs that permitted the project to work.

Nguyen was working on getting Ubuntu working with the PS5 Pro, but that relied on the "only hypervisor bug left", which has now been reported to Sony by the "slop kiddies." Which will presumably mean a patch from Sony and goodbye to the project.

The scene used to be a group of highly talented researchers, but now it is just a bunch of noobs using LLMs and writing hacks they don't even understand. Slop kiddies found the only hypervisor bug left, which I had also found a while ago, and decided to report to Sony. September 15, 2026

"I asked them [the people who found the hypervisor bug]," Nguyen says , "to at least wait for GTA 6 to come out so that people would have the opportunity to legally purchase the game and also enjoy Linux. They agreed to wait, but not a day passed and they decided to waste it instead."

I'm unsure how much of Nguyen stepping away has to do with this happening to the Pro project, and how much is the prevalence of "noobs." It seems like perhaps a little of column A and a little of column B. I'm not a dev so I can't say whether this kind of negative environment is encouraged by 'easier' development using AI, but it wouldn't surprise me.

items.title: iBuyPower RDY Scale B06 review
items.summary: It's a sign of how bad the memory crisis is that this rig doesn't feel super expensive.

content.v: I've got to the point where I grimace when I see a listing for a gaming PC. The memory crisis has so severely gutted pricing and availability that I've found my eyes glazing over PCs whenever they're on the screen in front of me.

One glance at our roundup of the best gaming PC deals shows that even getting a rig under $1,000 with a discrete graphics card is a bit of a struggle, and you are making significant compromises to get the price that… low . Okay, yes, it doesn't feel low, but that's the new normal. All praise our new AI overlords.

And iBuyPower routinely features among the most budget rigs. That's because, be it smart compromises, the ability to buy in bulk, or a prayer to some sort of hardware god, its rigs are somewhat reasonable for prebuilds.
The RDY Scale B06 I've had across my desk shoves a budget Intel CPU and budget Nvidia GPU into its surprisingly large case, alongside a pretty small SSD and single-channel memory.
Buy if…

✅ You can wait for a sale: At MSRP, I would look elsewhere, but iBuyPower regularly runs decent sales, and there have been two on this specific rig in the last week. With a few hundred shaved off, it becomes a fairly competitive mainstream build.
Don't buy if…

❌ You can afford a little more: The RTX 5060 GPU itself is a bit of a letdown, and though it will get solid enough 1080p gaming (and even 1440p at points), there are RTX 5070 machines not that far off this price.

Price

RDY is iBuyPower's preconfigured range, which means they are ready to ship pretty much the moment you hit 'buy'. As such, the RTX 5060 / Intel Core Ultra 5 225F model I've got my hands on is the only version of the B06 you can currently buy.
For its relatively budget-friendly price, it makes some compromises, the biggest of which you will find in its memory and storage.

The memory is DDR5, but with a CAS latency of 40 and overall speed of 5200 MT/s, it's not super fast. There's also only one stick, so you are taking a hit to performance over dual-channel memory of the same capacity. How much depends on the game or workload, but there will be a hit.

Should you have the funds and the patience, you could technically track down a second module matching this same stick and bump your capacity up to 32 GB, but that's a hard sell, and was even before the memory crisis. Most of the time, you are better off selling a single stick and buying two (at a loss) if you're looking to upgrade, as it can be tough to track down the exact stick you need and even that doesn't guarantee compatibility.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/wcnwctxqZYHM5VBS9G2yiG-1920-80.jpg

There's just 1 TB of storage in this machine. That is pretty much the minimum I would want in a gaming rig right now, especially when you consider the actual storage available to you will likely be 50-100 GB lower than 1 TB.

The 1 TB in my rig translates to 952 GB. That doesn't include browsers and any other Windows apps. Then, you might have Steam, Epic Games, likely the Nvidia app, plus any drivers, and any other media apps like Spotify. By only downloading the games I used for the benchmarks below, I was left with around 300 GB on the drive.

Now, we would have received twice the memory capacity for the price if it weren't for the memory crisis , but you have to expect to pay more for gaming PCs right now, and those compromises make some sense from iBuyPower.
Performance

This rig is a sign of how bad the memory crisis has gotten. Late last year, we checked out the Acer Predator Orion 3000 , which was just $20 more, came with a full-fat RTX 5070, a better Intel chip for multithreaded workloads, and even came in a cute compact case.

Because of that higher-tier GPU, the Orion outpaces this iBuyPower rig in every gaming test I conducted. Some by just a few frames, and some more convincingly so. Acer did make compromises here with PCIe 3.0 storage speed and 16 GB DDR4 memory, but it's still all in all a better rig, and a much more compact one. The caveat, though, is that while you can find RTX 5070 PCs at this price on occasion, they are becoming ever more rare, and this SKU of the Orion 3000 is nowhere to be seen these days.

items.title: 索尼PS6掌机新爆料:3A大作原生540P PSSR3.0进化！
items.summary: 近日，GameGPU带来了索尼全新掌机（代号Project Canis）的完整硬件与技术爆料，这款定位次世代的便携设备将于2027年末正式发售，主…

content.v: 近日，GameGPU带来了索尼全新掌机（代号Project Canis）的完整硬件与技术爆料，这款定位次世代的便携设备将于2027年末正式发售，主打适配PS5平台大作，凭借全新PSSR 3.0 AI超分技术实现性能越级表现。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609171223048843.png
据爆料信息，PSP3搭载定制3nm AMD Canis处理器，采用6核Zen6架构（4颗性能核+2颗能效核），配备24GB LPDDR5X统一内存、192位位宽，整机TDP功耗严格控制在15W-25W，兼顾便携续航与性能释放。显卡部分为RDNA5架构16CU计算单元，支持双发射FP32指令，掌机模式下主频1.2GHz，原生性能4.91TF；底座模式主频提升至1.65GHz，原生性能6.75TF。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609171223139881.png
受限于掌机功耗，PSP3运行3A大作原生渲染分辨率仅540p，但索尼自研的PSSR 3.0智能超分与帧生成技术彻底弥补了短板。依托专属硬件AI神经网络单元，设备可通过AI算法补全画面细节、重构纹理与几何信息，最终输出1080P清晰画面，稳定实现30-60帧流畅运行，帧生成功能还能翻倍动态场景流畅度。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609171223368214.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609171223252693.png
相比传统FSR软件超分，PSSR 3.0优势十分明显，规避了低分辨率拉伸带来的画面模糊、线条闪烁、运动拖影等问题，画质还原度远超普通空间滤波算法。借助这项AI黑科技，PSP3掌机模式等效性能可达10-11TF，电视底座模式更是飙升至14TF，十分接近16.7TF的PS5 Pro，远超原版PS5的10.28TF性能。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609171223591761.png
业内爆料人KeplerL2表示，专属AI加速单元将成为PSP3的核心竞争力。对比缩放技术薄弱的Switch2，PSP3可原生流畅运行PS4、PS5乃至未来PS6平台的游戏阵容，真正实现主机级大作便携化。

据IGN报道，索尼为PS5推送了版本号26.06‑14.00.00的系统固件更新，带来画质、社交、主页组件等多项功能优化，PS4也同步收到小版本补丁。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609171025137303.png
本次更新对于PS5 Pro用户尤为关键，增强PSSR画质提升功能现在默认开启，即便游戏只支持旧版PSSR，也会自动启用增强算法，带来更加锐利清晰的画面，玩家可以在设置当中手动关闭该选项。

items.title: 底特律变鬼了！开启DLSS5仿生人五官扭曲太阴间
items.summary: 近日，有玩家分享了一段《底特律：变人》的画面，展示了将DLSS 5超分辨率算法注入游戏后的“翻车”效果。原本用于提升画面重建质量…

content.v: 由你来说： 玩家把DLSS 5强行注入《底特律：变人》，结果仿生人全变鬼脸，五官扭曲成一团。你觉得这是技术翻车吗？你是否看好DLSS 5的前景。
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/origin_202609171631221355.gif
近日，有玩家分享了一段《底特律：变人》的画面，展示了将DLSS 5超分辨率算法注入游戏后的“翻车”效果。原本用于提升画面重建质量的技术，最终却让角色面部变成了一团严重拉伸、扭曲的像素状图像。
从曝光画面来看，角色脸部出现明显的“恐怖谷”效果，五官和皮肤纹理严重变形，视觉效果反而更加诡异。有网友分析认为，画面可能出现了多层Shader滤镜叠加以及不合适的缩放参数，在不受支持的游戏引擎环境中使用后，最终造成了几何结构反复扭曲，而没有带来预期的清晰度提升。
评论区也迅速玩起了梗，有玩家调侃“AI把仿生人变成真人了”，还有人直接称《底特律：变人》变成了“底特律：变鬼”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609171633191307.png
一些技术向玩家则指出，DLSS 5的相关重建流程需要依赖游戏引擎提供的运动矢量等数据，老游戏通过外部方式进行注入时，如果无法获得正确的输入信息，就可能出现重建异常。不过，也有人认为相关工具目前仍处于较早阶段，后续更新或许能够改善兼容性。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609171633205509.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609171633207272.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609171633214765.png
需要注意的是，这次画面异常属于非官方的外部注入尝试，并不能代表NVIDIA官方版本DLSS 5在游戏中的实际表现。

items.title: 今年第6个IGN10分！满分不值钱？还是质量无可挑剔
items.summary: 昨晚，《火焰纹章：万缕千丝》的媒体评价正式解禁，IGN为本作打出了10分满分的评价，虽然在媒体试玩阶段，《火焰纹章：万缕千丝》的…

content.v: 昨晚，《火焰纹章：万缕千丝》的媒体评价正式解禁，IGN为本作打出了10分满分的评价，虽然在媒体试玩阶段，《火焰纹章：万缕千丝》的口碑就已经相当之高，但IGN10分评价在今年多次出现，也让“IGN的满分是不是越来越常见了”成为玩家讨论的话题。
编辑观点： IGN今年来频繁出现10分评价，也确实难免让人怀疑满分的含金量。不过我始终认为，媒体评价永远只是一个参考，而非值得被奉为圭臬的金科玉律，一款游戏究竟值不值得满分，最后还是要看玩家个人的喜好。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609171236383239.png
首先，IGN今年已经为6款游戏打出满分评价，这其中既有相对小众的《混音青春》和《挖掘者米娜》，也有在单个类型中做到行业头部的《极限竞速：地平线6》和《鬼武者：剑之道》，既有抢先体验多年终于转正的老游戏《英灵神殿》，也有刚刚发售的《火焰纹章：万缕千丝》。
需要指出的是，一年当中有如此之多的IGN满分游戏是比较罕见的情况，上一次单年出现6个10分还要追溯到2023年。而考虑到未来还有《塞尔达传说：时之笛 重制版》和《GTA6》，今年的满分游戏可能会来到8款甚至更多。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609171237343066.jpg
许多玩家都认为，10分作为评分体系中的最高分，本身就应该具有一定稀缺性。如果一年里不断出现满分作品，那么难免会让人感到疑惑，一款游戏究竟需要达到什么程度才只配拿到9分，而什么样的表现又足以让它直接跨入10分？当最高分越来越频繁出现时，10分与9分之间的区分度也在随之降低。
更关键的是，IGN今年为《混音青春》和《挖掘者米娜》两款游戏打出满分时就曾身陷争议，许多玩家认为编辑在其中混入了过多的个人喜好，没有做到公正客观。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609171237548522.png
不过从另一个角度来看，满分数量增加也可能只是因为今年确实出现了更多能够打动评测者的作品。游戏类型越来越丰富，不同作品在玩法、叙事、艺术表现等方面各有所长，评测者也并非只按照“有没有缺点”来决定最终分数。只要核心体验足够突出，即使存在一些瑕疵，也可能达到评测者心中的10分标准。
那么，你怎么看IGN今年已经6次打出10分这件事？你觉得这是因为今年优秀游戏确实更多，还是10分作为最高评价正在变得越来越常见？如果满分作品数量继续增加，你还会把IGN的10分视为非常重要的参考标准吗？

content.v: 由你来说： 《火焰纹章：万缕千丝》锁30帧运行， 你认为2026年的游戏锁定30帧是否合理？
近日，玩家发现任天堂《火焰纹章》系列新作《火焰纹章：万缕千丝》在Switch 2平台上以锁定30fps运行。这一规格在海外玩家社群引发了集中讨论与不满。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609171206566389.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609171206592671.png
据海外玩家反馈，该作定价为80美元。有玩家认为，作为一款面向新世代硬件的第一方作品，锁定30fps与定价、硬件性能预期均不相符；也有玩家指出，若换作其他厂商以同等规格发售类似产品，舆论反应将更为严厉。日本玩家方面同样表达了对Switch 2平台专属作品帧率表现的关注，认为该平台在帧率优化上仍有改进空间。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609171207119387.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609171207118319.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609171207139815.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609171207144515.jpg
作为一款策略角色扮演游戏，30fps是否会显著影响实际游玩体验，仍需等待更多玩家的评价。 你认为新《火焰纹章》锁定30帧是否合理？欢迎在评论区留言讨论。

items.title: 游戏圈又现天价"分手费"！夫妻离婚被分近1亿元
items.summary: 据新浪财经报道，昨日，杭州电魂网络科技股份有限公司（《梦三国》《梦塔防》《次元战争》等）发布公告称，公司于9月15日收到实际控…

content.v: 据新浪财经报道，昨日，杭州电魂网络科技股份有限公司（《梦三国》《梦塔防》《次元战争》等）发布公告称，公司于9月15日收到实际控制人胡建平、陈芳通知，由于双方目前已办理完成解除婚姻关系手续，将对双方的股份分割做出相关安排。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609171013321975.jpg
据介绍，胡建平原持有约公司总股份5.78%，陈芳则持有约10.78%的股份，根据双方签署的离婚协议，胡建平将原持有的约3%的公司股份分割至陈芳名下。
截至9月16日收盘，电魂网络报13.07元/股，总市值31.73亿元。若按照收盘价格计算，胡建平分割股份市值超过9500万元。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609171014111425.jpg
权益变动办理完成后，胡建平持股数量降至675.75万股，持股比例2.78%；陈芳持股数量增至3346.14万股，持股比例提升至13.78%。

items.title: 《仁王3》突然更新！内容超多 体验大增强
items.summary: 《仁王3》是黑暗战国动作RPG《仁王》系列的最新作，由忍者组Team Ninja开发，光荣特库摩发行。游戏已于2月6日正式发售，登陆PC和PS5…

content.v: 《仁王3》是黑暗战国动作RPG《仁王》系列的最新作，由忍者组Team Ninja开发，光荣特库摩发行。游戏已于2月6日正式发售，登陆PC和PS5平台。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609171616326645.png
今日，光荣特库摩官方宣布《仁王3》Ver2.02.00版本更新现已在Steam与PS5平台发布，本次更新旨在修复各类问题。
具体公告如下：
功能增加与调整
新增稀有度为"神器"的百境百怪绘卷通关后有概率触发"添画"，并增加一项百境百怪绘卷的特殊效果（特殊效果最多为6项）
因应本次更新，将发放"百夜香"10个。百境百怪绘卷解锁后，可在神社的"赏赐"处领取。
提升"百夜香"的掉落率
追加重复通关强化状态下唤醒的敌方据点、小地狱时的达成奖励，且必定包含"百夜香"
问题修正
修正了武士武器"盾矛"武技"破城冲"、"破城冲 报"在琢技中使用时，特定条件下持续时间过长的问题
修正了奇谭"幕政的窒碍"中，义刃冢召唤的助战击败"河原十郎兵卫"时，不会变身为"烟烟罗"导致无法进行的问题
修正了"顿悟的旅途"难度下，地狱内出现的"地狱附身"在清除地狱后，不会在战绘卷中出现且无法将其击败的问题
修正了部分百境百怪绘卷标示"地形影响"为"地狱"时，根据故事进展导致绘卷内地形有时不会变化为地狱的问题
修正了套装效果"天钿女的恩宠"5件套"闪避行动移动距离延长"对部分武器未生效的问题
修正了归还"难行石·顿悟"后再次领取时，错误获得"难行石·将军"的问题
修正了将"工法书《怨嗟剑盾》"交给铁匠时，忍盾矛"怨嗟剑盾"无法解锁锻造的问题
若已交付工法书，更新后载入存档时将正常解锁
修正了防具"松平信纲的军扇"说明文字错误的问题
修正了达人"传林坊赖庆"部分台词与宍户景俊相同的问题
修正了在"1651年 庆安地狱变"地图内的神社参加多人游戏时，结束多人游戏后偶尔会飞出场景外，或在读取画面卡住无法进行游戏的问题
修正了其他轻微问题
PlayStation®5
问题修正
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609171616415318.png
修正了语言设置为"俄语"时，在"庆安地狱变"地图内特定神社无法存档的问题
【全体更新】
PlayStation®5 / Steam®
功能增加与调整
修改常世同行的房间搜索条件，启用"难行石"时，不再查看难行石的+值上限
调整"善擦帽子"装备时角色发型模型，使外观更加自然
问题修正
修正了任务"在幽冥之根的深渊中"的电梯消失导致无法进行的问题
修正了强化状态下唤醒的敌方据点、小地狱出现的"地狱附身"不会掉落稀有度"大名物"以上魂核的问题
修正了正面效果"多才多艺"未提升特定攻击的伤害及改变武技的属性伤害的问题
修正了体力侵蚀及正面效果"死里求生"降低体力回复上限时，体力满时仍触发部分特殊效果"无伤"条件的问题
修正了持有物品界面在新增饰品标签及风格分类标签时，忍者防具标签中出现饰品的问题
修正了"大和传大太刀"出现在魑魅加护及装扮设定装备列表中两处的问题
修正了房间搜索中"好友"条件下，房主将"配对区域"设置为非无限制时无法正确匹配的问题
修正了故事模式常世同行中完成未通关任务时，游玩记录内首次完成等级错误的问题
此次修正无法应用于已完成任务，带来不便敬请谅解
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609171616498686.png
修正了其他轻微问题

items.title: 《零游行》将于 11 月 3 日以导演剪辑版登陆 PS5
items.summary: 额外的故事、对话、模式等等。 ZA/UM 分享了 PS5 版《零游行：死亡间谍》

content.v: 额外的故事、对话、模式等等。
ZA/UM 分享了 PS5 版本的《零游行：死亡间谍》将于 2026 年 11 月 3 日作为扩展导演剪辑版推出，其中包含新内容、对话、模式和其他改进。
这将建立在广受好评的原始版本的基础上，该版本本身就是《极乐迪斯科》的众多精神继承者之一。当然，ZA/UM 确实开发了这款游戏，但制作《零游行》的团队与《极乐迪斯科》的团队本质上是不可识别的。工作室的大量混乱和离职意味着《极乐迪斯科》的许多创意主管没有留在《零游行》中。

items.title: 《FF7启示》Demo画面曝光 主机确认三种模式
items.summary: 知名游戏博主@Genki_JPN分享了东京电玩展期间《最终幻想7：启示》的试玩及相关游戏情报，内容整理如下

content.v: 知名游戏博主@Genki_JPN分享了东京电玩展期间《最终幻想7：启示》的试玩及相关游戏情报，内容整理如下：
《最终幻想7：启示》支持三种画面模式
画质模式：优先以 4K分辨率呈现游戏画面。
性能模式·锐利（Performance - Sharp）：优先保证 60FPS，同时提供更锐利的画面质量。
性能模式·流畅（Performance - Smooth）：同样优先保证 60FPS，但会采用相对柔和的画面表现。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609171644278242.png
博主表示，自己已经完整体验了《最终幻想7：启示》的TGS试玩Demo，并透露了Demo结尾部分的内容：
玩家击败巨大的杰诺瓦触手Boss后，会进入一片紫色烟雾之中。随后，低语者现身，它们的脸部变成了散发紫色光芒的球体。
低语者随后将玩家一行人带入尼布尔海姆回忆。此时萨菲罗斯也出现在其中，而且这段回忆似乎能够被整个队伍共同看到。
玩家跟随萨菲罗斯进入尼布尔海姆。回忆中的克劳德穿着神罗士兵制服，并与扎克斯一同出现。
克劳德解释称扎克斯是自己的朋友，但目前他的记忆依然十分模糊。蒂法知道当年真正发生过什么，因此显得十分担忧，却没有说出真相。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609171646444545.png
随后，众人看到尼布尔海姆的经典合影被重新拍摄。这一次，穿着神罗士兵制服的克劳德也出现在照片中，并与年轻的蒂法以及萨菲罗斯站在一起。扎克斯和一名神罗士兵则站在一旁。拍照结束后，萨菲罗斯随着低语者的紫色烟雾一同消失，试玩Demo也随之结束。

content.v: 前一段时间，随着索尼宣布结束与小岛秀夫在《PHYSINT》上的合作，外界纷纷猜测认为，小岛秀夫将无法继续使用PlayStation第一方工作室Guerrilla研发的Decima引擎。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609170944198680.png
而就在近日，小岛秀夫突然晒出了一组与知名芬兰游戏开发商Remedy多位骨干的合影，这些人分别是Remedy传播总监Thomas Puha、高级品牌经理Andrew Marshall、艺术总监Elmeri Raitanen合影。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609170929145928.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609170929166049.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609170929174479.jpg
很快在评论区，不少玩家都敏锐地意识到，和Guerrilla一样，Remedy也是一家拥有自研引擎的技术向游戏厂商，其Northlight引擎在多年的升级与迭代中被广泛应用到Remedy旗下的多款游戏，包括《量子破碎》、《控制》、《心灵杀手2》、《控制：共振》等作品。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609170946523075.png
因此，不少玩家都分析认为，小岛秀夫的《PHYSINT》或许将使用Remedy的Northlight引擎。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609170947561268.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609170929284179.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609170929287580.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609170929289214.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609170929296665.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609170929296264.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609170929302932.png
据了解，Northlight引擎的一大特点就是对大规模场景和高质量画面的支持，并且在光照和视觉效果方面的呈现也相当不错，引擎支持基于物理的渲染、全局光照以及完整的光线追踪技术，并针对区域光阴影和间接光照等效果进行了优化。
而除了图形技术之外，Northlight还拥有完整的游戏开发工具体系，包括AI、物理、音频、UI、脚本和调试工具等。其中，Remedy在《心灵杀手2》中将原有脚本语言替换为Luau，并开发了相应的工具链，让设计师和玩法程序员能够更加方便地制作关卡和游戏系统。引擎的Bonsai AI工具则用于控制NPC行为。
目前小岛秀夫已经正式和微软开启更深层次的合作，而值得一提的是，虽然并非子母公司，但Remedy也和微软有着非常深的历史合作关系：《心灵杀手》由微软负责发行，曾是Xbox 360重要的独占作品；《量子破碎》则是双方合作最紧密的作品；Remedy也曾多次在公开场合强调并赞扬双方的合作关系。
因此，如果未来小岛工作室真的选择与Remedy在技术层面展开更深入的合作，Northlight确实具备成为其潜在技术方案的基础。
不过，目前双方此次互动究竟只是工作人员之间的交流，还是与未来项目存在更深层次的合作关系，仍有待官方进一步确认。

content.v: 此前因视频中垃圾桶投篮配文“48”引发争议、并被LOL官方处罚的解说管泽元，近日新动态来了，全英文采访NBA球星杰森·塔图姆，流利的英语表达与专业的采访状态引发关注。
此前，管泽元为某活动拍摄的预热视频中，片头出现了他对着垃圾桶投篮并从“48”开始计数的画面。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609171537271984.png
在LPL圈内，“48”因谐音被部分人用作对BLG选手Bin的不当称呼，粉丝认为作为官方解说的管泽元此举系公开内涵选手。随后管泽元发文道歉，表示该设计仅为衔接篮球主题活动的开场引子，“并没有指向任何选手、粉丝群体或其他延伸含义”，并承认团队在内容把关上不够严谨。此后，LOL官方对其进行了处罚。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609171537121928.png
在经历风波后，管泽元全英文采访塔图姆，过程自然顺畅，展现出其扎实的英语功底与主持能力。

items.title: 第一人称类魂新作定价仅40刀 秋季档太疯狂降价求生
items.summary: 第一人称类魂游戏《不朽遗志》确认售价为40美元（约合人民币268元）。游戏发行商Lyrical Games表示，这一定价经过长时间讨论，主要…

content.v: 第一人称类魂游戏《不朽遗志》确认售价为40美元（约合人民币268元）。游戏发行商Lyrical Games表示，这一定价经过长时间讨论，主要考虑到今年秋季新作扎堆尤其是《GTA6》的上市。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609172303094227.png
Lyrical Games在声明中表示，过去一年里团队一直在讨论《不朽遗志》的最终售价。发行商认为，游戏拥有足够的品质、画面表现以及约20小时的剧情内容，完全具备与其他“全价游戏”正面竞争的实力。不过，今年秋季的新作阵容非常密集，玩家能够投入游戏的时间和预算都十分有限。
此前，《不朽遗志》已经从原定的9月24日延期至10月13日，以避开《控制共振》和《寂静岭: Townfall》等作品的竞争。然而，即便调整了发售时间，游戏仍将面对一个月后正式发售的《GTA6》。
因此，Lyrical Games最终选择了相对较低的40美元售价，希望降低玩家尝试这款新IP的门槛。不过，较低的定价也存在另一层风险——部分玩家可能会因此认为游戏的品质不如那些售价更高的作品。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609172303186734.png
在接受The Game Business采访时，Lyrical Games负责人Blake Rochkind进一步谈到了定价问题。他表示，团队对售价“进行了非常痛苦的反复权衡”，自己最大的担忧是40美元的价格可能会向玩家传递错误信号。
Rochkind表示，《不朽遗志》是今年秋季少数全新的IP之一，而今年秋季的游戏阵容堪称“这个行业历史上最疯狂的秋季档”。除了11月即将推出的《GTA6》之外，还有《塞尔达传说：时之笛》重制版、《控制共振》、《影之刃零》、《战争机器：E-Day》以及《使命召唤》等作品接连登场。
面对如此密集的竞争，《不朽遗志》只能依靠自身的定位和价格争取玩家。
Rochkind认为，团队对《不朽遗志》非常有信心，但最不应该做的事情就是在这种竞争环境下选择退缩。他希望玩家能够把《不朽遗志》视为一款可以与其他大作同时购买、同时体验的游戏，而不是必须二选一的作品。

content.v: Twitch boss Dan Clancy has said he expects an enormous launch for GTA 6 this November, one video game companies are right to avoid like the plague. But he also expects GTA 6 to continue to hoover up the internet’s attention when GTA Online 2 — or whatever GTA 6’s multiplayer mode is called — launches next year.
Speaking to Bloomberg , Clancy said he’d spoken with Rockstar Games about what the developer has up its sleeve.

“We spent a lot of time talking with Rockstar about their plans, and also helping them think about how they can engage our creators,” Clancy said. “You are going to see this big bump with GTA 6, but then an even bigger one next year when they launch multiplayer.”

Rockstar is yet to say when the multiplayer portion of GTA 6 will come out, or even confirm it plans to release a GTA Online 2, even though everyone knows it’s in the works. There is intense speculation about when it will release, or, more specifically, how long Rockstar will wait to deploy it after GTA 6’s November release date. Early 2027? Mid 2027? Late 2027? Either way, next year looks nailed on.

Will GTA Online 2 make the existing GTA Online redundant? Not necessarily. Last year, Strauss Zelnick, boss of Rockstar parent company Take-Two, said Take-Two has form when it came to NBA 2K Online, a free-to-play online-focused version of 2K Sports’ hugely successful basketball franchise aimed at the Asian market. NBA 2K Online launched all the way back in 2012, and then 2K Sports released NBA 2K Online 2 in 2017. Both games were maintained simultaneously, so fans of the first version could continue to play and invest their time and money safe in the knowledge they wouldn’t be left behind.

“I'm going to speak theoretically only because I'm not going to talk about a particular project when an announcement hasn't been made,” Zelnick told IGN . “But generally speaking, we support our properties when the consumers are involved with those titles. As an example, we launched NBA 2K Online in China, I think originally in 2012 if I'm not mistaken. And then we launched NBA 2K Online 2 in China in 2017. If I'm not mistaken. We did not sunset Online 1. They both are still in the market and they serve consumers and they're alive and we have this massive audience.
“So we've shown a willingness to support legacy titles when a community wants to be engaged with them.”

That last line is of particular importance. It suggests — but doesn’t confirm at this stage — that if there is a GTA Online 2, it won’t come at the cost of GTA Online falling by the wayside. If people keep playing GTA Online, Zelnick is suggesting here, then Rockstar will continue to support it. And let's remember, GTA 6 launches on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S only. PC players' only option is to join the console party, or stick with GTA 5 and GTA Online on PC.

With November fast approaching, Rockstar has begun to reveal more about GTA 6 and how it will play. Just this week a number of artists teased their appearance on the GTA 6 soundtrack , and Stephen Root, who voices Bill Dauterive and Buck Strickland on the animated series King of the Hill, confirmed his role in the GTA 6 cast .

Remarkably, Rockstar has yet to confirm any GTA 6 actors, leading fans to try to work out the cast for themselves. We don’t even know who plays Jason and Lucia, the game’s dual protagonists. Perhaps we won’t until the game is out in November and the credits roll.
While you wait to find out, check out IGN’s extensive GTA 6 coverage, including our interview with Rockstar’s Rob Nelson on what to expect .

items.title: 黎明行者的饥饿之血是与《博德之门 3》相匹配的黑暗冲动
items.summary: The Blood of Dawnwalker’s vampiric hunger system has turned me into a serial NPC killer, and it's like Baldur'

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/17/dark-urge-blog-1789650630385.jpg

This is an IGN opinion piece from Matt Purslow, who loves RPGs both on the tabletop and in video game form. He appreciates any game that has an interesting take on the evil within, probably because his first ever RPG character was the son of the god of murder.

My sword slices through the final soldier. As his body hits the forest floor, my work here is done: I have saved two innocent men from being marched to the draining camps. Ambrus, the vampire that rules over this region of Vale Sangora, is rounding up civilians and bottling their blood to create a stockpile of sustenance. It’s my job to disrupt all that, and this latest round of vigilante slaughter is part of that task. These men will not be drained today.
Well, at least not by Ambrus’ troops.

You see, I’ve made the poor decision of conducting this mission at night. When the moon rises, I become a vampire myself, and while that grants me a suite of helpful abilities, such as being able to turn into a wolf and walk up walls, it also means I need to feast on blood. And, well, after all that slaughter, I’m pretty hungry.

As the two men thank me for my heroics, my regular dialogue choices are replaced with “Give in to the hunger.” I resist, choosing the only option that will push forward the conversation. One of the men promises to give me a suitable reward for saving his life. All my response options have been overridden by the hunger. I refuse to select one. The fangs come out anyway. So much for saving these men from being drained.

In The Blood of Dawnwalker, being a vampire truly is a curse. Protagonist Coen is sired in the story’s early hours, but it’s an imperfect transformation; during the day he remains a human, but at night the vampirism takes over. Regular health-restoring items like food and water become impossible to palette, and so only blood can repair his wounds. But the red stuff isn’t just a nice-to-have; it’s a necessity. An addiction. And so if you let Coen’s HP linger in the bottom section of his health bar, where it flashes like a warning beacon, you risk the hunger taking over. When you enter conversations, dialogue options are replaced by “Give in to the hunger.” Resist too long, and Coen will chow down on whoever is in front of him… regardless of how important they are to the plot. Yes, you can accidentally kill anyone and everyone , from random civilians to major quest-giving NPCs. Never before has it been so important to keep your belly full.

Coen is far from the only “monster” protagonist in RPGs. Obsidian Entertainment is fascinated by the idea, allowing you to murder most NPCs in its The Outer Worlds duology and Fallout: New Vegas, as well as building an entire campaign around the idea of evil in Tyranny. But Coen feels like an interesting reflection of the Dark Urge, Baldur’s Gate 3’s optional origin story that casts you as a depraved serial killer. As the Dark Urge, you’re given additional layers of choice that allow you to revel in your grisly nature – the most famous of which is probably being able to tear off the hand of wizard Gale when you first meet him, killing the potential companion before he can be recruited.

Like Baldur’s Gate 3’s most sinister origin, Coen quite literally has a dark urge that pushes him to do unspeakable things. But while these characters are reflections of each other, their symmetry is warped. Coen’s urge is systemic – there are conditions that, when met, will trigger his uncontrollable hunger, which can disrupt the decisions you’ve made. The Dark Urge, meanwhile, layers additional choices into Baldur’s Gate 3 that allow you to author your own story of a serial killer navigating the tentacled apocalypse. These two approaches to choice create two very different takes on a similar idea.

With the Dark Urge, it’s all about crafting your character’s journey. Throughout the course of the story, a Dark Urge player is presented with many, many additional dialogue options and scenarios that allow them to engage with more sinister ideas than those presented to the more “traditional” Baldur’s Gate player characters. During the first act, for instance, the Dark Urge is given the opportunity to mutilate animals, break the legs of a refugee, bite off a goblin’s toe, brutally murder a companion following a steamy nocturnal engagement, and butcher one of the game’s most beloved NPCs.

By presenting these as options, rather than uncontrollable desires, each becomes a story branch that you choose to enact, which in turn allows you to shape the Dark Urge’s personality. Perhaps your version of this character has a code, like the titular serial killer of the AMC show Dexter, and will only murder a particular kind of personality. Maybe they’re an animal lover and will refrain from plucking the wings off injured birds. And then there’s what’s widely considered the most satisfying manner in which to play the Dark Urge: the redemption arc, in which you wrestle with your inner darkness and try to become the hero that the Sword Coast needs.

To make that redemption arc feel authentic, there does need to be some systemic elements that ensure your urges are just beyond your control, and so there are a few moments where you must pass a skill check dice roll in order to suppress your murderous intent. But for the most part, the experience of the Dark Urge is about writing your own destiny – how will your choices define your murderer?

There is, of course, crossover between Baldur’s Gate 3’s Dark Urge and The Blood of Dawnwalker. As Coen, there are several opportunities to tread a purposefully grisly path, and your dialogue choices will dictate the kind of man he becomes. But as my accidental feast demonstrates, controlling Coen’s dark urge is more about mastering Dawnwalker’s systems. It’s vital to understand how his hunger works, as that understanding allows you to make informed gameplay decisions that can keep that hunger in check.

For instance, a reasonably early quest tasked me with breaking into a jail to rescue the local miller. After scoping out the small castle during the day, I gathered enough intelligence to understand that this prison break was best conducted at night, as there would be fewer guards. And so after dark I used my vampiric powers to teleport over the fence, pilfered the cell key, and freed my quarry. However, fewer guards doesn’t mean no guards at all, and so I was forced to spill some blood on my way out – Dawnwalker unfortunately doesn’t feature any genuine stealth systems, and so even the sneakiest plans typically require some direct confrontation.

The battle left my health bar in the flashing red, and so when it came to the quest’s final conversation with the prisoner before he was free to leave, my dialogue options began to shudder, replaced by that ominous “Give in to the hunger.” The sudden panic this induces is deeply effective – unlike the men I’d accidentally drained earlier, this prisoner was a more significant character in the story. I really didn’t want to eat him. Suddenly, I was re-thinking all my choices – why didn’t I drink a blood vial before talking with the prisoner? Was there a way out that didn’t involve combat? Why didn’t I do this quest in the day, when there’s no risk of hunger?

content.v: Bloomwalking into a familiar series.

As part of yesterday's Xbox Tokyo Games Show event, Netmarble shared another look at Bloomwalker , its upcoming crafting adventure. Aside from announcing that the game will launch on Switch 1 & 2, the studio also revealed that the title is officially part of the Ni no Kuni universe.

It has been a little while since we got a first peek at Bloomwalker, but it looks like it'll be right at home on Nintendo consoles. It's got all manner of cosiness that we love to see on the system, as you travel across a pollution-ravaged land with your moving house (yes really) and adorable nature spirit pals, and there's more than enough crafting that we can imagine portability will be a welcome addition.

items.summary: October is going to be a tough month for anyone on a budget, as a ton of big games are coming up. Sandwiched b

content.v: October is going to be a tough month for anyone on a budget, as a ton of big games are coming up. Sandwiched between an already-packed September and the November release of GTA 6 , how does any game stand out from the pack? In the case of Valor Mortis, a launch price of $40--and day-one availability via Xbox Game Pass--might be a winning combination to help it shift units.

"We've had many discussions over the past year about the price of Valor Mortis," developer One More Level and publisher Lyrical Games wrote in a statement. "We believe the game has the quality, fidelity, and playtime in its 20-hour story to go toe-to-toe with many 'full price' titles. Still, this fall is stacked, and there's high demand for your time and money."

One More Level added that cosmetic packs will also be released in the next few months, and if players want to support the studio, they can purchase a Deluxe Edition that includes unique weapon skins alongside the base game and a "major" story expansion arriving in 2027.

Speaking to The Game Business , Lyrical Games boss Blake Rochkind said the decision to price Valor Mortis at $40 came from confidence in the game. "We find ourselves as one of the only new IPs launching in what is objectively the craziest fall in the history of this business," Rochkind said. "Not only do you have GTA looming large in November, now you have the Zelda remake, Control coming out in a couple of weeks, Silent Hill: Townfall, Phantom Blade Zero, Gears of War, Call of Duty--by virtue of the development schedule, the cards we’ve been dealt is that we are one of the only new IPs launching this fall."

Rochkind added that selling Valor Mortis for $40 allows it to be an "and game," something that players could add to their basket while purchasing one of the high-priced titles out later this year. Having it launch day one through Game Pass also helps it reach players who might have ignored it and probably wouldn't have bought it in the first place. "Game Pass has reached a maturity point in this business where there are 'Game Pass gamers'--people who play games on Game Pass and were unlikely to buy the game day and date anyway," Rochkind explained. "We're happy to be on Game Pass, and I’m not really concerned about cannibalization. For every game that is ‘cannibalized’ by Game Pass, another game gets amazing word-of-mouth because of it."

Announced last year, Valor Mortis is a new entry in the souls-like genre, but with a twist—it's in first-person. Set during the Napoleonic Wars, players find themselves exploring European battlefields infested with strange monsters caused by a mysterious, plague-like substance. As a revived Grande Armée soldier known only as William, it's up to you to master strange new skills and powers to stay one step ahead of Napoleon's monsters and their telegraphed attack patterns.
Originally scheduled to launch on September 24, Valor Mortis will now launch for PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S on October 13.

content.v: 开发商兼发行商 Funcom 在 PlayStation 5 与 XBOX 上正式开启厄拉科斯的大门，豪华版与终极版玩家的抢先体验同步启动。这款开放世界生存游戏灵感源自弗兰克·赫伯特的《沙丘》，以及传奇影业与丹尼斯·维伦纽瓦打造的卖座电影系列，将于9 月 22 日正式登陆主机平台。

为庆祝本次更新上线，《沙丘：觉醒》现已在 Steam 开启五折优惠——这是游戏迄今力度最大的一次折扣，活动持续至 10 月 8 日。

不仅更大，而且更好，新内容一览
今日的 PC 更新与主机发售，是《沙丘：觉醒》团队一年来在扩展、强化与打磨这款游戏上所付出努力的集大成之作。

数小时新增剧情内容，为游戏沉浸式、电影化的沙丘故事第一册画上史诗终章。
海量优化与改进，覆盖性能到玩法的方方面面。

而这只是最新的一步。今日的更新，应放在过去 15 个月中为这款游戏所做的数百项新增与改进的脉络中来看——所有这些内容都将在 PlayStation® 5 与 XBOX 上首发即享。其中包括

沙漠腹地的终局体验分为 PvE 与 PvP 两套实例，后者风险更高，回报也更丰厚。
你不必再失去任何东西：基地可以保存、载具可以找回、税收取消、死亡惩罚降低，以及更多。
全面重制的终局内容，以任务为核心，玩家将在厄崔迪家族或哈克南家族的阵营中逐级晋升。
新增地图、地下城、武器、动态遭遇战等。
全新成长系统：增幅（Augmentations）与专精（Specializations）。
动作玩法与战斗手感打磨，尤其是近战。
性能全面提升，得益于主机端优化工作的带动。
https://image.gcores.com/4f6c42a2c0cce0f2086908fdb201bc99-2963-1675.png

PlayStation 5 与 XBOX 抢先体验开启，Steam 五折不容错过
《沙丘：觉醒》将在 PlayStation 5 与 XBOX 上开启抢先体验，直至 9 月 22 日正式发售。凡购买豪华版或终极版的玩家均可进入。现在购买任一版本，即可立即开启你的厄拉科斯冒险。预购还可获得"穆阿迪布生态箱"——传说中沙鼠的居所，可放置在自己的基地内。PC 玩家方面，《沙丘：觉醒》现已五折发售，为游戏史上最高折扣力度。

《沙丘：觉醒》现已在 PlayStation 5、PlayStation 5 Pro、XBOX Series X|S 与 Windows 商店上线，并完整支持 XBOX Play Anywhere。这意味着，无论你是在 XBOX 主机、Windows PC、ROG XBOX Ally 掌机上，还是通过 XBOX 云游戏游玩，游戏进度都将同步继承。跨平台联机已确认将于发售后上线。游戏还将于 9 月 22 日加入 XBOX Game Pass；若会员希望提前开玩，可以八折购买豪华版或终极版。

《沙丘：觉醒》在 PlayStation 5、PlayStation 5 Pro 与 XBOX Series X 上提供两种模式：性能模式（60fps、动态 4K） 与画质模式（30fps、动态 4K） 。PlayStation 5 Pro 与 XBOX Series X 在画质模式下可实现更高的原生分辨率与增强的画面表现。游戏的 UI 与操作也已全面适配主机；当沙虫逼近、致命的震颤袭来时，手柄的触觉反馈将被发挥到极致。
实体版同步登陆线下零售与线上渠道
《沙丘：觉醒》PlayStation 5 实体版同步发售（没错，是有光盘的）。欧洲、澳大利亚与新西兰地区由万代南梦宫娱乐（Bandai Namco Entertainment）发行，美洲地区由 Solutions 2 GO 发行，日本由 Spike Chunsoft 发行。日本发售日定为 10 月 29 日。

items.title: 《Valor Mortis》因“该行业历史上最疯狂的下跌”而损失 40 美元
items.summary: Promising first-person action soulslike Valor Mortis has a confirmed $40 price point, which was settled upon b

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/17/vm-1789654000214.jpg
Promising first-person action soulslike Valor Mortis has a confirmed $40 price point, which was settled upon by its publisher because of the fall crush fueled by GTA 6.

“We have had many discussions over the past year about the price of Valor Mortis,” publisher Lyrical Games said in a statement. “We believe the game has the quality, fidelity, and playtime in its 20-hour story to go toe-to-toe with many ‘full-price’ titles. Still, this Fall is stacked and there’s high demand for your time and money.”

Valor Mortis was already delayed from September 24 to October 13 to avoid the likes of Remedy’s Control Resonant and Konami’s Silent Hill: Townfall, but it also faces the looming launch of GTA 6 a month later. The hope is that by going with a cheaper price than some of its competitors it’ll stand out further, but what comes with that is the risk that some will feel it’s not as good.
In an interview with The Game Business , Lyrical Games boss Blake Rochkind expanded on the decision, admitting the price was something “we’ve really agonized over.”
“My biggest concern was that it would send the wrong message about the game. But this decision is made out of confidence,” he said.

“We find ourselves as one of the only new IPs launching in what is objectively the craziest fall in the history of this business. Not only do you have GTA looming large in November, now you have the Zelda remake, Control coming out in a couple of weeks, Silent Hill: Townfall, Phantom Blade Zero, Gears of War, Call of Duty... By virtue of the development schedule, the cards we’ve been dealt is that we are one of the only new IPs launching this fall.

“We are pretty confident in Valor Mortis. But ultimately, the worst thing we could do is not push our chips in and say, ‘We want this to be a game that you can pick up alongside these other great games.’”

This latter point is that Valor Mortis could be a game people buy as well as another, perhaps more expensive game, and a $40 price point makes that decision easier. Perhaps someone plans to buy GTA 6, which at its cheapest costs $80, but wouldn't mind snapping up Valor Mortis at half the price to play in the weeks beforehand.
Or maybe they will play Control Resonant and also Valor Mortis, or any other combination. “Going with this price point will help us be an ‘and’ game,” Rochkind said.
It’s worth noting that Valor Mortis is a day one Xbox Game Pass release, although Rochkind insisted this had nothing to do with the pricing decision.

From the creators of Ghostrunner, Valor Mortis is a first-person soulslike where you rise from death as a former soldier of Napoleon’s army, only to die over and over again battling shambling corpses and wild monsters. You can get a rundown on Valor Mortis in our recent preview.

items.title: 影视飓风"暴力"吐槽苹果 理想高管：TIM这次真敢说
items.summary: 理想汽车公关部社交媒体总监 “硬哥” 发文，点评了影视飓风创始人Tim的新机评测，直言这次评测尺度极大。

content.v: 理想汽车公关部社交媒体总监 “硬哥” 发文，点评了影视飓风创始人Tim的新机评测，直言这次评测尺度极大。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609172204047671.png
“硬哥”表示：这次Tim真的是超敢说，可变光圈是今年iPhone的最大亮点，Tim的评价居然是拉。拍照软件部分的更新，不给旧手机开放，吐槽。
iso不可调吐槽。内屏下摄像头比拉更拉。展开后拍摄预览画面很尴尬。长时间录像烫手……这么大尺度的首发评测吐槽，确实是很罕见的。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609172203552314.png
这场热议的源头，源自影视飓风刚刚解禁的iPhone Duo和iPhone 18 Pro的首发上手视频。作为苹果首款折叠屏手机，Tim在发布会现场就对这款机型做了可靠性测试。他把手机完全展开后，轻轻反向掰动机身，当时并未看出异常，回看录制画面才发现，该机外屏已经出现闪屏。
Tim强调，自己并没有用力操作，折叠屏的机身耐用度，和传统直板机型存在明显差距。
除了结构可靠性，散热也是一大硬伤。Tim表示，iPhone Duo日常使用温度尚可，但一旦开启录像等高负载任务，摄像头下方就会急剧升温，堪称他测过发热最严重的机型之一。
视频同时曝光了iPhone Duo 屏下摄像头的短板。这款内屏搭载了苹果量产机首款屏下前置镜头，做到了无挖孔全屏显示，可实际拍摄效果却不尽人意。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609172204192579.png
与此同时，Tim还指出了iPhone 18 Pro的影像缺陷。这款机型首发配备机械式可变光圈，4800 万像素主摄支持 f/1.48、f/1.8、f/2.8、f/4.0 四档光圈切换，被苹果称作迄今最先进的手机摄像头。
但实测发现，光圈全开时，只要侧面有光线射入，就会产生大面积眩光，严重破坏成片效果，Tim直言这一光学表现 “拉完了”。

items.title: 我的猫分散游戏：整洁电子游戏超市宣布推出 PC 版
items.summary: If you're a gamer who likes organizing your physical collection and you're looking for a new cozy game to play

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/16/mycatscatteredgames-trailer-blogroll-1789587600998.jpg

If you're a gamer who likes organizing your physical collection and you're looking for a new cozy game to play, indie developer ODIUS and publisher Loopr Partners's My Cat Scattered Games: Tidy Videogame Supermarket might be exactly what you want. Bonus points if you like cats. My Cat Scattered Games is a literal title: your in-game cat has taken your gargantuan physical games collection (represented here as funny, legally distinct versions of their real-life counterparts) and, as cats do, scattered them all over your the place. It's up to you to pick them all up and reorganize them on your shelves.

You can organize over 6,000 games and consoles such as "Lovable Kombat," "Mega Bavario 64," and "Red Spirit 2" for systems like the "Kekstation 2" and "Y-box." You'll also need to rescue your cat, who after making this mess, somehow got itself trapped in a claw machine. Check out the first trailer above and the first screenshots in the gallery below.

"The job sounds simple enough," the developer says. "Pick up a game, identify its platform, find the right section, and put it back on the shelf. But with thousands of discs, cartridges, consoles, and other gaming treasures scattered across the store, keeping everything organized is easier said than done. Each shelf can hold up to three different games and ten copies of each title, giving players plenty of room to develop their own sorting strategy. As the store gradually comes back together, players can discover parody game covers, jokes, and references inspired by different eras of video game history."

You'll unlock ways to speed up your sorting and organization as you progress, but there are no ways to fail the game or lose. It's completely cozy and go-at-your-own-pace. [ Editor's Note: It's almost like this was built for me and my mild OCD.] My Cat Scattered Games will be released for PC on October 9, and you can wishlist it on Steam if you're interested.

items.summary: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 is one of the most-anticipated game releases ever, and despite the enormous hype

content.v: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 is one of the most-anticipated game releases ever, and despite the enormous hype, Rockstar and owner Take-Two are going to market the game aggressively. Why does the game even need a marketing push? According to Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick, just because a franchise is popular and well known, that doesn't mean the company behind it can take their foot off the pedal in terms of spending time and money on marketing.
Zelnick said 2023's The Barbie Movie is a good example of this.

“All of us saw the Barbie movie, and they marketed the living daylights out of that picture. Even though the IP is very well known. Secondly, it was out there for a while. We all got the joke of what it was going to be. They did a phenomenal marketing campaign. It was really everywhere, and, by the way, it worked," he told GamesBeat .
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Jason_and_Lucia_08_a1e5d2.jpg?w=636
For any "broad-based entertainment" property, companies "don't have a choice" but to spend significantly to push a new release, and GTA 6 is no exception, Zelnick said.
"You always have to go out and create enthusiasm. So, awareness is one thing; enthusiasm is another thing. And we have to show people what they’re going to get," Zelnick said.

He said Take-Two's investors have asked him why the company needs to aggressively push GTA 6 when it's a game everyone on Earth knows about. Zelnick said he learned from his time as a movie executive years ago that if your product is no good, "you can market the living sh** out of it, and people will still not notice the marketing." And if the marketing is terrible, "you can turn people off." If the marketing is good, however, "you can create more excitmement."

"And the whole goal that we always have, whether it’s this upcoming launch or any other title, is to take awareness and turn it into excitement, and take the lack of awareness and turn it into awareness," he said.

Also in the interview, Zelnick said Rockstar's partnership with Netflix for the GTA 6 extended trailer was akin to a "tutorial" to help fans see the game in action and understand why they should buy it.

“What Rockstar did was incredible, but there was an element of tutorial baked in there, right? It just was a different kind of proposition," he said. "If you look at Rockstar’s marketing previously for Grand Theft Auto titles, there are actual tutorials. This was just a different way of giving the same information, which I thought was really impressive. Rockstar figured out how to do that to entertain us for 27 minutes while also explaining to us how you’re going to play the game."

GTA 6 releases on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, with a PC version expected to follow sometime after. In other news, Rockstar just announced GTA 6: The Album, and unlike the game itself, it will be available on a disc .

items.title: 《GTA6》全新官图公开！露西娅杰森帅爆了
items.summary: 今日，《GTA6》实体版原声专辑正式开启预购，共推出CD、黑胶唱片和限量版黑胶三种版本。

content.v: 今日，《GTA6》实体版原声专辑正式开启预购，共推出CD、黑胶唱片和限量版黑胶三种版本。其中，CD版售价19.98美元（约合人民币134元），黑胶版售价49.98美元（约合人民币335元），限量版黑胶售价124.98美元（约合人民币838元）。
与此同时，官方发布的实体专辑宣传图中还曝光了数张《GTA6》男女主角的新图片。整体视觉风格延续了此前公开的宣传海报，以粉红色、橙色为主色调，并加入标志性的棕榈树元素。，男女主角依靠在汽车旁，呈现出浓郁的《GTA6》迈阿密风格。

items.title: 全网最无聊的博主，在全球评测了300张公园长椅
items.summary: 只要让男人感到无聊，他们什么都干得出来！

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2022/10/21/small_202210211829418927.png
全网最无聊的“评测”博主出现了。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/09/20260917_hhy_641_2/10348.jpg
当那些追求流量的人，为了吸引人们的注意，去评测各种稀奇古怪的东西（比如杯子）时。在无人注意的角落，一个吃饱了撑了的人却不追求流量，默默评测着公园长椅，且一评就是7年。
这个吃饱了撑的人叫“萨姆·威尔莫特”，一个Instagram上没啥名气的英国博主。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/09/20260917_hhy_641_2/10916.jpg
2019年至今，他已经在全球多个国家完成了近300张公园长椅的评测。这些椅子样式、材质、位置各有不同，有像沙发一样的红杉木雕椅、乳制品厂里奶牛造型的石椅、音乐节上那些由啤酒桶搭成的“长椅”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/09/20260917_hhy_641_2/12822.jpg
每每遇到各类长椅，萨姆肥硕的大屁股都会忍不住想上去过过瘾，然后对“它”进行一番评头论足。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/09/20260917_hhy_641_2/13850.jpg
在萨姆“严格”的打分体系里，想找到一把满分的长椅，条件可以说相当苛刻。必须从舒适度、造型、风景，乃至是心情等多个角度进行考量，尤其是心情。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/09/20260917_hhy_641_2/15206.jpg
坐两个板的长椅切记调整角度，不然容易卡住某种东西
不同于国内自媒体的流量思维，萨姆的账号可谓相当佛系。
不刻意营造噱头，也没什么令人瞠目的爆点，7年多的时间，他的账号只积累了不到3万的粉丝。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/09/20260917_hhy_641_2/16499.jpg
尽管在大多数人看来，评测一个随处可见的“长椅”没意义且无聊，但萨姆却乐在其中。
而这场与长椅的“畸形恋”几乎贯穿了他7年的人生，更由此延伸出了一个又一个温馨有爱的故事。
他是真的爱长椅，以至于我怀疑他离世的那一天，可能会带着一张长椅进墓地。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/09/20260917_hhy_641_2/18187.jpg
2019年底，萨姆在英国斯旺西大学完成了学业。
毕业当天，他邀请同学一同评测了学校的长椅。那是一张工业流水线生产的铁椅，几块铁板生硬地拼凑在一起，然后批量被投放到学校各处。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/09/20260917_hhy_641_2/20273.jpg
它的存在似乎仅仅为了满足人对“坐”的基本需求。椅子触感冰凉坚硬，没有铭牌，也没有扶手，椅面遗留的雨水还浸湿了他的学士服。
坐在长椅上，你能看见面前寂寥的草地，以及远处三三两两分别的人群。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/09/20260917_hhy_641_2/25422.jpg
对于他们而言，这次的离别，很难说下次何时才能再见。
那把椅子萨姆最终只给了3分，低分的原因或许出于离别的伤感、糟糕的体验，或者单纯只是因为那场雨有点冷。
爷爷八十岁生日当天，萨姆终于说服了老人家来一起评测长椅。
这位亲历过二战的老人虽已白发苍苍，却精神矍铄，就像他背后那栋历史悠久的古建筑一样，古朴厚重，平静沉稳。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/09/20260917_hhy_641_2/27518.jpg
爷孙俩选了一张树荫下的褐色长椅，这把老旧的椅子大概已有些年头。木板上的油漆已随时间剥落，边角的螺栓已经松动，凳面不算宽阔，但扶手的握感不错。
这把椅子最终得了6分，这在萨姆的评分体系中已算难得的高分。
或许那把又丑又旧的长椅本身不值这个分数，但彼时的旧景旧物旧人，似乎让它值得。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/09/20260917_hhy_641_2/27683.jpg
那可是“我和我爷爷”
疫情那段时间，大概是萨姆最苦闷的时光。短暂失去四处游荡的自由，让他没办法再去寻找那些藏在人们视野外的独特长椅。
即便面对这样的处境，他仍然不想放弃评测的快乐。可家里的后院实在没有长椅供他消遣，那就评测一个烂树墩吧。
尽管它实在没什么值得被称赞的优点，且坐上去还会时不时被墙外的汽笛声叨扰，但这仍然比外面部分政府为应付指标而设立的长椅好。
所以它值得一个2分。
在这样日复一日的评测中，萨姆从一位刚毕业的现代史硕士，变成了某家公司的招聘专员，人也变得愈发变瘦、帅气。
刚才那个胖子呢？
7年来即便他的账号一如既往没多少人关注，却也仍然打消不掉他对长椅的热情。
在追寻椅子的旅途中，萨姆独爱那些带有铭牌的椅子。
不同于那些市政为完成指标而投放的长椅，英国的城市与乡野有着许多个人或机构捐赠的椅子。它们的材质五花八门，样式千奇百怪，却几乎都承担着同一使命——纪念那些逝去的人或事。
譬如萨姆人生中遇到的第一把9分长椅。
那是为了纪念一名叫做“康纳·霍尔”的少年而建的椅子。多年前，这名少年因一次交通事故从自行车上跌落，让生命永远定格在了16岁。
康纳当时带了头盔，却没有系紧，导致头部受到重创。此后多年，他的家人和朋友积极投身公益事业，呼吁青少年骑车时正确系紧头盔。
那把木质的纪念长椅呈弧形摆放，椅面离地面不算高，又长又宽，椅背由两块木板拼成，长而高阔，无论是老人还是孩子坐着都很安全。
15年过去了，除了康纳的家人，或许已经很难有人还记得那个开朗帅气的少年。有关他的记忆被锤定成了这张墓地边的长椅，向每一位往来者倾诉少年未完的故事。
它真的很舒适，也很安全，就像康纳父母那追悔莫及的心言。
在街口、在乡间、在山下、在湖边，那些长椅上毫不起眼的铭牌，寥寥数十字却承载着一个人漫长的人生。他们是一战中没能归家的丈夫；名噪小镇的摇滚乐手；51岁喜爱摩托车的中年人。
共性的是，他们都是无人树碑立像的普通人。除了亲朋友人的怀念，这世上他还只剩一张椅子摆在那，证明他来过，你记得。
今年6月，萨姆的账号迎来了史上第一个10分（满分）长椅。
那是英国格罗斯特郡的一座教堂，一把质朴的浅灰色木椅伫立在一个平平无奇的山岗上。目之所及是与天相连的绿野，与朵朵相连的白云蓝天。
实际上早在2021年，萨姆就曾评测过这把椅子，并给出了9分的成绩，他给出的理由很简单：
舒适。
舒适的座椅环境、铭牌、位置、风景，以及心情。可能它的每一点都达不到完美，但在那一天坐上它，真的很让人舒适。
而5年后，为这9分补满分数的则是“舒适的伴侣”——他的妻子Soph。
目之所见，依然是那片绿野与蓝天白云，只是这次不同的是，椅子上的人变成了两个。

items.title: TGS 2026：JRPG《记忆边缘》11月5日发售
items.summary: Nacon与Midgar Studio宣布，JRPG《记忆边缘》将于11月5日发售，登陆PS5、Xbox Series和PC Steam平台。发售日宣传片： Corrosion，这场前所未有的瘟疫，已经摧毁了Astrya

content.v: Nacon与Midgar Studio宣布，JRPG《记忆边缘》将于11月5日发售，登陆PS5、Xbox Series和PC Steam平台。
发售日宣传片：

Corrosion，这场前所未有的瘟疫，已经摧毁了Astryan大陆。而在世界的另一端，Avaris大陆及其游牧民族——迄今为止尚未受到这场可怕瘟疫的波及——此刻也走到了灭绝的边缘。Eline，一位漂泊的灵魂低语者，正毫不留情地与那股将这片丰饶土地上曾经的生灵变成诡异怪物的力量抗争。在一次神秘的遭遇后，她体内觉醒了一股黑暗力量，这股力量或许正是结束这场末日浩劫的关键：掌控自身Corrosion的能力。
然而，挽救一个看似已注定毁灭的世界绝非易事。在Ysoris（她不太可能的导师）和Kanta（一位失落部落的萨满王子）的协助下，Eline必须战胜阻碍在她面前的强大敌人。
激烈的实时战斗
与盟友并肩，与冷酷的敌人展开激战，释放你的强大力量将他们一举击溃！
通过在快速打击和毁灭性技能间灵活切换，组合出华丽的连击，主宰战场。
盟友是致胜的关键。个性化设置同伴，在关键时刻巧妙运用他们的技能，造成更大伤害。
让愤怒将你吞噬，化身狂战士，发出震撼大地的重击，随后展开一连串无情的杀戮。
一个令人惊叹而又腐朽的世界
Avaris，这片拥有多重面貌的土地，和 Heryon 的其他地方一样满目疮痍。从海港城市 Sarlah-Durah 田园般的沙滩到 Kezal 山脉的雪峰，每一处风景都留下了 Corrosion 怪物的痕迹。
探索被 Corrosion 控制的 Avaris 大陆——发现色彩缤纷的丰富环境，目睹这场灾难如何肆虐这些迷人的风景。随着故事的推进，游戏会改变你曾踏足的地方，开辟出奇异的新路径。
骑乘 Nekaroo——驾驭这只忠诚的猫科动物伙伴穿越 Avaris 的广袤大地，利用它的敏捷性探索难以抵达的区域。
欣赏受日本动画启发的惊艳视觉效果——借助Unreal Engine 5，穿越 Avaris，这个色彩缤纷、光芒四射的大陆，探索并重新发现Heryon的惊人世界。
一个扣人心弦、毫无冗余的故事
一部引人入胜的史诗巨作，毫无注水内容——体验原创叙事，每个任务都至关重要，为故事、角色或他们之间的关系增添新的深度。
沉浸在情感旅程中——穿越游牧文明为躲避 Corrosion 而被迫迁徙的大陆，与那些选择等待死亡、同时庆祝生命的人们交流。
一段诗意的配乐

无论你是在探索 Avaris 大陆的辽阔疆域，还是在与冷酷无情的 Corrosion 敌人作战，都可以欣赏由 Cédric Menendez 创作的动态且适应性强的配乐。在 NieR:Automata™ 中以作品而闻名的 Emi Evans 迷人嗓音引领下，你的旅程最终以 Yasunori Mitsuda 创作的终极主题曲达到高潮，他因在 Chrono Trigger®, Xenoblade Chronicles™ 和 Sea of Stars 等游戏中的杰作而闻名。

需要 64 位处理器和操作系统

items.title: 重新定义!岛哥哥:《PHYSINT》是我四十年集大成之作
items.summary: 今日，小岛工作室公开了旗下两款新作《OD》与《PHYSINT》的最新开发进展。

content.v: 今日，小岛工作室公开了旗下两款新作《OD》与《PHYSINT》的最新开发进展。
关于谍战动作新作 《PHYSINT》，小岛秀夫表示，本作是一款战术谍报动作游戏，不受既有类型的束缚，将在未来的数字娱乐领域重新定义次世代的“谍报动作游戏”体验，也将成为他四十余年创作生涯的集大成之作。他强调，项目从未停下脚步，一直在持续推进。此外，选角、演员扫描以及与外部艺术家的合作等工作也都在进行中。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/17/small_202609172146375840.png
此前，小岛秀夫已在Xbox东京电玩展发布会上确认，《PHYSINT》由Xbox发行，并公布主角演员为 Bill Skarsgard。而恐怖新作 《OD》 的开发同样进展顺利，在SAG罢工期间暂停的动作捕捉与ADR录制工作已于今年恢复，Sophia Lillis与Hunter Schafer及整个团队贡献了激烈而出色的表演。
目前，两款作品的具体发售日期与登陆平台细节仍有待官方后续公布。

content.v: 在TGS 2026上，发行商Dragami Games和Nada Holdings，以及开发商JP Universe宣布，《电锯甜心2 Back2Back》将于2027年发售，登陆PS5平台。玩家还可以在TGS 2026上试玩该游戏。
《电锯甜心2 Back2Back》的制作人员包括曾执导《最终幻想15》的田畑端，以及曾参与制作并编写初代《电锯甜心》剧本的结城正弘，还有负责初代主角概念艺术的NekoshowguN。
【TGS 26】最疯狂的美国金发辣妹回来了！《电锯甜心2 Back2Back》系列新作实机游玩
以下是Dragami Games提供的游戏概述：
风靡全球的可爱高中僵尸猎人回来了！
《电锯甜心2 Back2Back》是《电锯甜心》系列的全新作品。
朱丽叶身着全新装束，力量更胜以往，重返重建后的圣罗梅罗。如今的圣罗梅罗已摇身一变，成为一座名为“贾里德伍德”的庞大都市，围绕着电影产业而建。一位神秘导演将她困于自己扭曲的僵尸电影之中，朱丽叶必须与盟友并肩作战，揭开混乱背后的阴谋，并阻止来自腐化领域的僵尸带来的新威胁。
敬请关注更多信息，该产品计划于2027年发布。
