items.title: Metroid Ravenous Logo Memes Make Phrases Like “Girl Dinner” And “They Took My Ass” Look So Metal
items.summary: Hype emanating from the reveal of Metroid Ravenous has translated into an onslaught of memes after a logo gene

content.v: Hype emanating from the reveal of Metroid Ravenous has translated into an onslaught of memes after a logo generator circulated online. If you're on Reddit or Bluesky, you may have seen the instantly iconic image of Samus Aran aggressively pinning down a mysterious enemy for consumption, but now accompanied by stupid text like "I ASKED FOR NO PICKLES" in the Metroid Ravenous font.

The Pixelframe Design website unveiled a tool that lets anyone input any text and style it to look like the grainy and jagged Metroid Ravenous logo, with four options for the image background. Pixelframe Design previously made similar logo generators for games like GTA 6 , The Duskbloods , and famously, Pokopia .

The apparent hook of Metroid Ravenous is Samus's need to kill and consume her enemies to survive. Naturally, that has led to food-related memes like a riff on the "55 burgers" scene from I Think You Should Leave, a reference to the viral concept of "girl dinner," or a simple but effective "Om Nom Nom" joke . Literally any wording you put into the generator will look more badass in this font.

It's also been amusing to see other video game titles like Hello Kitty Island Adventure in the Ravenous font face, and several other of these memes are just vulgar and gross enough to be hilarious . Don't expect any of this to become official Nintendo marketing material.

The Metroid subreddit was briefly jam-packed with these images, leading to moderators creating a megathread devoted to the meme template . Hilariously, many of the top-upvoted comments are Ravenous memes dunking on the mods.

Revealed during the September 2026 Nintendo Direct , Metroid Ravenous is a follow-up to 2021's Metroid Dread and a return to the 2D track of the franchise. While Nintendo hasn't officially commented on who is developing Ravenous, Dread studio MercurySteam hinted that it's behind the upcoming title on social media. Metroid Ravenous releases on January 28, 2027, and a special edition coming with a steelbook and Amiibo figure will also come out.

items.title: Resident Evil Director Was In Horrible Pain Making The Movie
items.summary: Resident Evil director Zach Cregger has revealed he was going through hell while making the movie, which is ab

content.v: Resident Evil director Zach Cregger has revealed he was going through hell while making the movie, which is about a man going through hell.

He told The Hollywood Reporter that he had pneumonia for the first half of filming on Resident Evil. For the second half of production, he had Campylobacter jejuni. This causes diarrhea, and man, that sucks for anyone, but especially if you're trying to film a big-budget, highly anticipated film based on a property with legions of fans and great expectations creatively and commercially.
"So I was very, very ill for the whole production, and everything felt so barely in control because my body was failing me," Cregger explained.

Cregger said he credits his "wonderful, talented" department leads to help him through, while he also praised Resident Evil star Austin Abrams for going above and beyond. He said Abrams is "one of the most can-do, positive people I’ve ever met. I was spoiled by the people around me."

Not only was Cregger physically sick while making Resident Evil, he had to deal with freezing-cold conditions in the north of the Czech Republic where the movie was filmed. "We froze our asses off," he said.
This wasn't the first time Cregger was dealing with physical turmoil while making a movie. On his last film, Weapons, it was so hot and humid that he needed an IV and directed scenes remotely .

Resident Evil releases on September 18, and it's expected to have a huge, record-setting opening weekend . The movie stars Austin Abrams as a medical courier named Bryan who is an "idiot" everyman who finds himself in a world of pain.

items.title: Resident Evil Creator Shinji Mikami to Be Inducted Into D.I.C.E. Hall of Fame
items.summary: Resident Evil creator Shinji Mikami will officially be honored with the Hall of Fame Award at the 30th Annual

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/16/mikami-1789583860592.png
Resident Evil creator Shinji Mikami will officially be honored with the Hall of Fame Award at the 30th Annual D.I.C.E. Awards ceremony on February 18, 2027.

The Academy of Interactive Arts & Sciences (AIAS) announced the news today and shared that Grasshopper Manufacture's Goichi Suda (SUDA51) will present the award to his "close friend and creative collaborator."

“It was from Mikami-san that I learned how to approach game development, both as a director and as a designer. Of all the many Padawans Mikami-san has mentored, I’m truly honored that I was chosen to be his presenter for this induction into a kind of video game hall of fame,” said Suda. “As one such Padawan, please allow me to celebrate my Obi-Wan Kenobi, Shinji Mikami, through this honorable award. I’m sure Mikami-san’s innumerable fans and industry comrades are just as delighted as I am to see him receive such an amazing award.”
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/16/mikami-1789583803689.png

Mikami's career has spanned over 30 years and his catalog of games is nearly unmatched, including Resident Evil, Devil May Cry, Dino Crisis, The Evil Within, Hi-Fi Rush, Vanquish, Ghostwire: Tokyo, and many more.
He is currently the Creative Director and CEO of Unbound Inc., which was purchased by Stellar Blade developer Shift Up earlier this year and is currently working on an unannounced video game.

“Shinji Mikami is a monumental and influential figure for both fans and developers alike,” said Meggan Scavio, president of the AIAS. “He has continually demonstrated his originality and creative vision that resonates and inspires the action game genre. We are honored to be able to celebrate Mikami-san’s achievements and induct him into our Hall of Fame during our 30th anniversary of the D.I.C.E. Awards.”

Mikami will join such past AIAS Hall of Fame recipients as Evan Wells (2026), Ted Price (2025), Koji Kondo (2024), Tim Schafer (2022), Ed Boon (2021), Connie Booth (2020), Bonnie Ross (2019), and Todd Howard (2017).
For more, check out Mikami's thoughts on what makes a good remake and how it's up to developers to make games people want to play, not just stream.
Adam Bankhurst is a writer for IGN. You can follow him on X/Twitter @AdamBankhurst, Instagram, and TikTok, and listen to his show, Talking Disney Magic.

items.title: Marvel's Wolverine Players Are Testing Its Motorcycle Sequence to See if Logan Can Die if You Don't Touch the Controller
items.summary: Marvel’s Wolverine has kicked off no end of debates on social media, with the latest of these centering around

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/07/22/ps-studios-blog-1784719617494.jpg
Marvel’s Wolverine has kicked off no end of debates on social media, with the latest of these centering around a chase sequence that sees Logan weaving through traffic on a motorcycle.

Insomniac’s new superhero game is the latest hot-button topic in the gaming community. Well before it even released, players were calling out early gameplay footage shown off by the media, taking umbrage with a Sentinel boss fight (it was too formulaic), its voice acting (who hired these anime voice actors for my grisly X-Men game?) and Logan following a scent trail to track down enemies (too hand-holdy).

Now that it’s finally out in the wild, players have had a swath of mixed opinions on the title; some are absolutely loving it and finding it a decent challenge, while others are disappointed by its combat, perceived lack of difficulty, and impossible-to-fail QTEs.

This last complaint has reared its head specifically around a sequence where players are meant to chase down enemies on a motorcycle, dodging and weaving through traffic on a winding highway in the mountains. Logan is desperately trying to rescue a group of captured mutants who’ve been shoved onto a truck, and the situation is dire — but some players have discovered that he’ll successfully catch up to the bad guys regardless of whether or not you actually pilot him in the right direction.

One of the most viral examples of this came from an X user named Clint Beastwood, who claimed to have put down his controller to see what would happen to Logan if he didn’t interfere. The result was Logan bouncing off of guard rails like a high-stakes game of pinball, somehow making his way through the sequence without dying.

However, it is possible for him to die after getting hit by on coming vehicles, though he’s paradoxically more likely to meet an untimely end if players actually take hold of the controller and try to help him avoid ending up like a bug on someone’s windshield.
He CAN die. You do not need to control the bike. https://t.co/76EI4lDAy8 pic.twitter.com/6mPKHnxNne

The resulting conversation has been a heated one; players are at odds with each other, with some finding this a comparatively small issue in a sequence meant to get players from point A to point B, while others, like YouTuber ChicoFilo, are calling the lack of player agency “just ridiculous.”
“This here is a total disgrace,” Brazilian influencer Eloohzinha said. “It's [a] QTE that you don't even need to press, it's a bike that you don't need to ride.”

Isso aqui é esculacho total. É QTE que você nao precisa apertar, é moto que voce nao precisa pilotar. É pérola atras de perola. Realmente, o prego no caixão foi esse wolverine. Ultimo jogo bom do estudio foi Ratchet And Clank e ja era. pic.twitter.com/hRUFzxmNDe
Decided to play Wolverine on the HARDEST difficulty and honestly it's been fun but this is just ridiculous 😭 #Wolverine #Playstation pic.twitter.com/fnoqSKazV6

“If Wolverine gets hit while on the bike, he can die. So you do need to control the bike. It’s posts like this that hurt real conversations around games,” popular YouTuber Mightykeef argued. “...if you can die, then it’s not autopilot. You need to control the bike, or else you can die and start over again. This type of on-rails segment happens in hundreds of action games.”

“Keyword being ‘if,’ when ‘if’ shouldn’t exist,” another user hit back. “There’s plenty of videos already out there showing players getting through the entire sequence without dying, regardless of difficulty.”
Keyword being “ IF “ when “ IF “ shouldn’t exist. There’s plenty of videos already out there showing players getting through the entire sequence without dying. Regardless of difficulty.

For now, players will just have to pick up the game themselves to form their own opinions on it. We at IGN gave it a six out of 10 , saying its “good character work props up flashy combat that wears thin over time.” (Personally, I’m enjoying the game so far, and haven’t been annoyed by scent trails or QTEs just yet. I also liked the Omega Red boss fight, which seems to have been tripping up quite a few players onine.)

We’ve got 17 Essential Tips and Tricks to help you get started in Marvel’s Wolverine, plus our recommendations for the 10 Best Adaptations , and a guide on How to Farm XP Quickly . Check out our full Marvel’s Wolverine Walkthrough for a step-by-step guide to every mission, and make sure you don’t miss a thing with our Collectibles guides, All Wolverine Suits and Claws Guide , and our thorough list of all the Easter Eggs and References we've found.

items.title: GTA 5 的“成为名人”模组功能几乎很奇怪
items.summary: 我想成为明星。
items.titleEn: GTA 5's 'Become a celebrity' mod is almost weirdly fully featured

content.v: 我每天都在修改《GTA 5》，要么将其转变为 PC 版本的《GTA 6》，要么彻底破坏它。明天回来看看我对 Rockstar 的宝宝做了什么新的可怕的事情，或者看看我之前做了什么。
你可能听说过我现在是马克·扎克伯格。这是真实的。甚至无可争议。但有些不对劲——无论他走到哪里，扎克伯格酷原创都会被认出来。他是一个著名的，或者说是臭名昭著的人。当我在《侠盗猎车手 5》中的洛桑托斯闲逛时，即使我是 Facebook 模仿版的极其富有的所有者，也没有人认出我。
不再。我安装了“成为名人”模组（巧合的是，与“LifeInvader Business Mod”来自同一作者），目的是成为镇上的名人。与 LifeInvader mod 一样，它的功能集实际上相当令人印象深刻：该 mod 在不同的轴上衡量您的公众认可度和整体声誉，并允许您进行一些可重复的任务来改变两者。
当然，你一开始的名气为零，而你唯一能做的就是所谓的“Z-lister”演出来提高名气。这意味着：街头表演。这意味着：在洛斯桑托斯周围的不同地点进行超过 20 次街头表演，每次表演可为您带来约 500 美元和 0.5 名誉点（名誉点并不多）。这是相当艰巨的，并且由于飞行汽车、帮派战争等而变得更加困难。
而且，人们似乎并不欣赏它。当富兰克林站在市政厅的台阶上，用吉他弹奏他的心声时，只有他雇佣的保镖发出了掌声。在其他地方，洛桑托斯要么冷漠地看着他，要么忽视他，要么死了（因为危险，你看）。有时，为了公平地对待坚忍的人群，富兰克林的吉他弹奏动画不会触发，他的 15 秒表演将由他站着不动和做鬼脸组成。
不过我做到了。所有 20 场演出，最终让我登上了新的名誉顶峰，并接受了一种全新类型的演出：见面会。在洛桑托斯商业区一个阳光明媚的地方，我的粉丝聚集在一起崇拜我。他们欢呼、鼓掌、上下弹跳，而富兰克林则一动不动地站着，茫然地凝视着中距离。这就是全部内容。这是我应得的。
当我的大部分粉丝被一辆卡车撞倒时，活动结束了。

items.title: Lego Batman: Legacy Of The Dark Knight Gives Harley Quinn An Arkham Asylum Makeover
items.summary: Lego Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight was a fun tribute to the Caped Crusader when it launched earlier this y

content.v: Lego Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight was a fun tribute to the Caped Crusader when it launched earlier this year, but if you're tired of saving Gotham, you can embrace chaos with two of the city's greatest villains: Harley Quinn and the Joker. The duo are headlining the game's Mayhem Collection expansion, and just like Batman, they're dressing in style with multiple outfits that you can unlock during their caper. GameSpot can exclusively reveal one of them: a classic costume for Harley Quinn, pulled directly from 2009's Batman: Arkham Asylum.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/LEGO-Batman-Legacy-of-the-Dark-Knight-Harley-Quinn-Arkham-Asylum-Outfit.jpg?w=636

While Harley Quinn predominantly wore a jester's outfit throughout her appearances in Batman: The Animated Series and related comic books, Rocksteady's Arkham Asylum game saw her switch up her look dramatically for what can best be described as a doctor-themed dominatrix. Out with the spandex onesie, in with a repurposed doctor's outfit, leather corset, domino mask, and other elements that paid homage to her roots. In Lego Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight, this costume is described as having prankster pigtails and a "chaotic" corset.

In case you missed it, the Mayhem Collection draws heavily from Batman: The Animated Series, with developer TT Games calling the expansion a love letter to the landmark '90s show that introduced Harley Quinn as the Joker's sidekick. Fans can find several references to the series in the Mayhem Collection, along with Easter eggs for other Batman shows, films, games, and comic book stories. There's even a nod to Harley Quinn's original voice actor, the late Arleen Sorkin, and the new story mission chronicles the first meeting between the Joker and Quinn, back when she was still the ambitious psychiatrist Dr. Harleen Quinzel.

The Mayhem Collection launches on September 18 for Lego Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight, one of the best games of 2026 . It's also coming to Switch 2 on the same day, and it's also available for PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S.

items.title: 《火焰之纹章：财富的编织》的精彩评论让我感觉害怕错过
items.summary: 我们又来了：一款新的《火焰之纹章》游戏获得了好评，我想这可能就是其中之一
items.titleEn: Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave’s Fantastic Reviews Have Me Feeling FOMO

content.v: 我们又来了：一款新的《火焰之纹章》游戏获得了好评，我想这可能是我最终喜欢的一款。 《火焰纹章：财富之网》将于明天在 Switch 2 上推出，在 GameSpot 的姊妹网站 Metacritic 上获得了 89 分的高分（截至发布时）。目前，它在 Metacritic 的 2026 年最佳游戏排行榜上名列第 13 位。
此外，GameSpot 的《火焰纹章：财富编织》评论称这是“未来游戏要打破的新高点”。作为一个原本不打算购买策略角色扮演游戏的人，我现在正在重新审视自己。我有购买广受好评的《火焰之纹章》游戏的历史，尝试了大约五个小时，然后又转而购买其他游戏。 2019 年 Switch 上的《火焰纹章：三宫》尤其如此。

在此之前，我第一次涉足该系列是在 2013 年，当时我在 Nintendo 3DS 上玩《火焰纹章：觉醒》，如果你不认为我是在《任天堂明星大乱斗》中扮演马尔斯的话。这是我仍然在我的 3DS XL 上下载的游戏，它位于我床头柜的抽屉里。我曾多次尝试参与游戏，但几个小时后就停止了。再说一次，我并不不喜欢回合制动作，但由于某种原因，它永远不会完全连接。我显然属于少数派，因为火焰纹章觉醒基本上拯救了整个系列。
之前接触《火焰之纹章》系列的经历让我一直忽视《财富之网》，直到现在。我看到人们对 Switch 2 独占版的高度赞扬，感觉我可能会错过一款精彩的游戏。当然，我现在正在玩《亵渎》，在购买打折促销后，《最终幻想 7 重制版》正在等着我。但如果《Fortune's Weave》是一款最终引起我共鸣的《火焰之纹章》游戏呢？
《火焰之纹章：财富的编织》将于明天（9 月 17 日）在 Switch 2 上推出。

items.title: 《使命召唤：黑色行动》开发者戏弄“以前没有人经历过的事情”
items.summary: 资深《使命召唤》开发商 Treyarch 即将完成《黑色行动 7》的工作，并转向下一个项目
items.titleEn: Call Of Duty: Black Ops Dev Teases “Something That Nobody’s Ever Experienced Before”

content.v: 资深《使命召唤》开发商 Treyarch 即将完成《黑色行动 7》的工作，并转向下一个项目，但那会是什么？这还有待观察，但 Treyarch 设计总监 Kevin Drew 在新的 Dev Talk 视频中表示，这可能不是你所期望的。
德鲁表示，Treyarch 在 2024 年的《黑色行动 6》和 2025 年的《黑色行动 7》的工作中“学到了很多东西”，并且“在我们这个时代尝试了很多东西”。
“但我们已经准备好创造一些新的东西，一些以前没有人经历过的东西，”他说。
这听起来有些夸张和极端，而《使命召唤》工作室绝对以宏大的主张而闻名。
Treyarch 创作的《黑色行动》系列于 2010 年首次推出，至今仍然是该系列中最受欢迎的品牌之一。不同寻常的是，《黑色行动》游戏在 2024 年和 2025 年连续推出，Treyarch 自己也承认确实担心系列疲劳。
EA 的《战地 6》销量在 2025 年超过了《黑色行动 7》，其中《黑色行动 7》跌至年度第五名，至少在美国是如此。在《使命召唤》的另一次重大调整中，微软宣布从今年的《使命召唤：现代战争 4》开始，使命召唤游戏将不再包含在 Xbox Game Pass 中。
Infinity Ward 正在主导《现代战争 4》的开发，不过与往常一样，动视的《使命召唤》工作室网络（包括 Treyarch）预计将为游戏的整体开发做出贡献。
一个与《使命召唤》相关的有趣传闻称，拥有《使命召唤》和动视暴雪的微软正在考虑让《使命召唤》工作室开发一款光环游戏。另一条传言称，微软可能“将 Halo 纳入动视暴雪旗下”，作为更大规模重组的一部分，以帮助 Halo 重新获得在 FPS 市场的主导地位。

items.title: Balatro 开发者 LocalThunk 在 Discord 上谈论 1.1 更新和倦怠后的生活：“我现在确实度过了制作游戏的最美好的时光”
items.summary: Balatro 1.1 更新推迟到 2026 年已经过去一年了。
items.titleEn: Balatro developer LocalThunk turns up on Discord to talk about the 1.1 update and life after burnout: 'I truly am having the best time making the game now'

content.v: 自从我们上次听说 Balatro 的 1.1 重大更新以来，已经有一段时间了，自从开发者 LocalThunk 将其推迟到 2026 年以来，几乎到了这一天。目前还没有任何迹象，但社区昨天确实看到了 LocalThunk，当时他突然出现在 Balatro Discord 中，让大家知道一切进展顺利。
LocalThunk 写道：“我很高兴泄密事件进展顺利。”他指的是他自己发布的有关 1.1 更新的调侃。例如：
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/oUayrAW3szSCwi7Y4j9Tn3-1920-80.png
“我知道你们想尽可能多地了解 1.1，但我不能透露太多。我知道这花了很长时间，而且我已经完全超过了 2025 年的时间框架，但我保证我会以最适合我和最终适合游戏的方式进行烹饪。”
这可以追溯到 LocalThunk 在 2025 年发布的关于 1.1 版本延迟的消息，他在消息中表示，在 Balatro 的开发上花费了太长时间之后，他“彻底精疲力尽”了。长时间休息后，他“非常缓慢地”重新投入工作，更像是一个业余爱好开发者，避开最后期限，而不是“试图创造性地强迫事情发生”。他还对宣布 1.1 更新的 2025 年发布目标表示遗憾，他在新消息中重申了这一点。
Localtnunk 继续说道：“我理解这一定是多么令人沮丧，我希望我能回到过去，给自己一些理智。” “当时还是很热闹，我从来没有考虑过我可以让自己停下来，然后移动版问世后，我就精疲力尽了，有一段时间无法接触游戏了。幸运的是，事情已经改变了。”
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/put9UYbPkJyMPQweujDPH4-1920-80.png
因此，LocalThunk 表示他将继续时不时地出现在 Balatro Discord 中，向人们保证 1.1 更新仍在开发中，并且可能会发布更多“泄密信息”，但在准备就绪之前不会对发布目标做出任何承诺。他还明确表示，尽管知道人们可能会因漫长的等待而感到沮丧，但他不会加快进度：“我不希望这款游戏半成品而毁掉巴拉特罗，我也喜欢这款游戏，我想玩一款有趣的游戏，而不是一个仓促的糟糕工作。”
“我现在确实在制作游戏中度过了最美好的时光。过去一年的开发可能是我做过的最有成就感的工作，包括发布前的时间，当时它只是一个小爱好项目，”LocalThunk 总结道。 “我正在尝试尽可能保持离线状态，因为这对我来说很有效，但当 1.1 准备就绪时我会放松下来。”
根据记录，Balatro Discord 上的人们没有表现出 LocalThunk 担心的沮丧或不耐烦的迹象：大多数回复都对他做得很好表示高兴，并鼓励他慢慢来。一位显然是 Discord 的新人对开发人员的出现感到特别兴奋：
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/kp9Pj6qGurpsMLjWsT5sr3-1920-80.png

对于渴望了解更新内容的 Balatro 负责人来说，LocalThunk 分享的不仅仅是上面的“四个小丑”花絮。主要观点都集中在这个 Reddit 帖子中：名为 Lunker 的 2 级优惠券、选择下一张优惠券的算法更改、蓝色赌注返工等等。不过，真正让我惊讶的是，LocalThunk 预计 1.1 更新将是这条路的终点：在 1.1 更新到来后，1.1.1 更新将随之而来，“根据玩家反馈进行平衡性调整和更改”。
“很可能就是这样，”他写道。 “别指望更多了。”他还确认巴拉特罗不会有多人游戏模式。
现在应该不言而喻，但无论如何我还是要说：Balatro 1.1 更新听起来会很大，但绝对没有迹象表明它何时到来。
